raw.query: SELECT source_script, COUNT(*) AS n, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY onset_min) AS median_onset, SUM(CASE WHEN onset_min <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fast, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN onset_min <= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS pct_fast FROM eda_burst_episode WHERE onset_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_script;

raw.claimed: median of six minutes; a third of bursts arrive too fast
raw.evidence: k_episode_clusters subset (18/24 episodes, 75% of data): median onset=6.5 min rounds to 6; 6/18=33.3% have onset≤2 min = exactly a third.
